import PrioQueue.Spec

namespace PrioQueue

def isSorted : List Entry → Bool
  | [] => true
  | [_] => true
  | a :: b :: rest => if decide (a.prio ≤ b.prio) then isSorted (b :: rest) else false

def insertList (e : Entry) : List Entry → List Entry
  | [] => [e]
  | x :: xs => if decide (e.prio < x.prio) then e :: x :: xs else x :: insertList e xs

def step : Impl := fun s op =>
  match op with
  | .insert e =>
    if isSorted s.items && decide (s.items.length < s.capacity) then
      (Outcome.ok, { capacity := s.capacity, items := insertList e s.items })
    else
      (Outcome.rejected, s)
  | .pop =>
    if isSorted s.items then
      match s.items with
      | [] => (Outcome.rejected, s)
      | e :: rest => (Outcome.got e, { capacity := s.capacity, items := rest })
    else
      (Outcome.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop   : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_capacity       : CapacityBound step := sorry
theorem req_pop_min        : PopMin step := sorry
theorem req_sorted         : KeepsSorted step := sorry
theorem req_insert_effects : InsertEffects step := sorry
theorem req_pop_effects    : PopEffects step := sorry
theorem req_fifo_ties      : FifoTies step := sorry

end PrioQueue
